name: Male Female Friendship
overview: Scripture highlights the value and challenges of friendship, emphasizing that true friends love consistently and support one another through adversity, as a brother would. Friendship requires intentional kindness and trust, with warnings against those who sow strife or repeat faults, which can separate even close friends. The mutual sharpening and encouragement found in godly relationships bring strength and growth, demonstrating that two working together have greater reward than one alone.
